original.target_description: Locator restricts target to birds-endowed condition. Source gives descriptive counts for that condition, but printed odds ratio and chi-square compare BOTH endowment conditions; no within-birds inferential test identified.

n.exclusions: Five excluded for misunderstanding endowed category. Main cross-condition chi-square additionally excludes equal-number estimates; this does not establish analytic subset for an unspecified within-birds test.

notes: Identity inspected: canonical text contains the full two-page primary Short Report, The Value Heuristic in Judgments of Relative Frequency, by Xianchi Dai, Klaus Wertenbroch, and C. Miguel Brendl, Psychological Science, Volume 19—Number 1, pp. 18–19, copyright 2008. Title, authors, journal, year and pages match the neutral reference. DOI is not printed; provenance header identifies the Wharton faculty published-paper file. Method, Results, Discussion and References are present. No PDF supplied. Target correspondence unresolved: description explicitly names birds-endowed condition. Its descriptive count is 32 participants (8 estimated fewer flowers than birds; 21 estimated fewer birds than flowers). This is not an established analytic N for a separately reported within-condition test. Candidate odds ratio 3.28, chi-square 4.51 and p .037 compare BOTH endowment conditions, with explicit analytic N 56 after excluding ties (footnote 2). Neither this cross-condition candidate nor its N is assigned to the narrower locator. No conversion or N derivation performed. Randomness-rating correlation r = –.047, N 63, p .712 concerns a distinct predictor and is excluded. Replication and success are unassigned placeholders.
